lines.en: I make my way over to the Chosokabe apartment to hang out with Chinami because I'm a fucking mess and this is what I do now.
lines.zh: 我跑去 Chosokabe 公寓跟 Chinami 待着，因为我就是一团他妈的烂摊子，而这就是我现在干的事。

lines.en: When I get there, she's eating cereal and watching TV. So I decide to join her because what the fuck else am I going to do with a girl her age?
lines.zh: 我到那儿时，她正在吃麦片看电视。于是我决定陪她一起，因为跟她这个年纪的女孩，我还能干他妈的别的什么？

lines.en: Don't answer that question. If you answer that question, you'll be damning me. And I won't be damned. Not like this. Not while incessant laughter bleeds through this flatscreen's speakers.
lines.zh: 别回答这个问题。你要是回答，就是在咒我。而我不会被咒。不能这么被咒。不能在这台平板电视的扬声器里不断渗出的笑声中被咒。

lines.en: We watch commercials. Just commercials. No actual TV. Chinami says it's always like this in the morning. Chinami says she doesn't mind.
lines.zh: 我们看广告。只看广告。没有正经电视节目。Chinami 说早上向来如此。Chinami 说她不介意。

lines.en: But I mind. I need to be distracted before a part of me breaks even more and I wind up perpetuating a cycle that I, too, was- no.
lines.zh: 但我介意。我得让自己分心，免得我又有一部分碎得更厉害，最后延续那个我自己也曾身陷其中的循环——不。

lines.en: Think better things. Think of what {i}she{/i} would say if {i}she{/i} saw you here. Think, you fucking idiot. {i}Remember.{/i} How would {i}she{/i} feel?
lines.zh: 想点更好的。想想{i}她{/i}要是看见你在这儿会说什么。想，你这他妈的白痴。{i}记住{/i}。{i}她{/i}会怎么想？

lines.en: Was it worth it? Did you watch commercials with her too, AKIRA?
lines.zh: 值得吗？你也跟她一起看过广告吗，AKIRA？

lines.en: Did she sit on your FUCKING lap and QUESTION what was POKING her, you fucking FREAK?
lines.zh: 她有没有坐在你他妈的腿上，问戳着她的是什么东西，你这个变态？

lines.en: JUST BECAUSE SUMMER'S OVER DOESN'T MEAN YOU SHAN'T {i}TAKE{/i}
lines.zh: 夏天结束了，也不代表你不用——
